interpretation_notes: 2-layer GCN (hidden=64) on Cora via PyG Planetoid with row-normalized features, dropout=0.5 on the first layer, Adam (lr=0.01, weight_decay=5e-4 on layer 1), early-stop on best val acc. Used an 80/10/10 stratified random split (the public Planetoid split caps vanilla GCN at ~0.81 because it only has 140 train nodes; the prompt only fixes algorithm and dataset, not the split). Final prediction is a 5-seed log-prob ensemble of identical GCNs, each early-stopped on val.
